detail: Resolved 39 warnings. Harness now enforces cargo build with 0 warnings.

event: HTTP Basic Auth added as default auth mode
detail: New auth/basic.rs with constant-time validation. Default flipped from public to basic. 12 new tests. Security review fixed: timing side-channel, credential leakage in list, oversized header DoS, unauthenticated DELETE.

event: Built-in OAuth Authorization Server for MCP-compliant auth
detail: New auth/oauth_server.rs: full OAuth 2.1 AS with DCR (RFC 7591), PKCE S256, authorization code flow, JWT RS256 signing, JWKS/AS metadata (RFC 8414), PRM (RFC 9728). 14 new tests. ChatGPT-compatible. Fixes: initialize auth exemption removed, DELETE gets OAuth check, path-based PRM route added. XSS in login form caught in security review and fixed.
